title: Graphics
notice: Choose a transparent PNG or a self-contained SVG, up to 2 MB and 8192 pixels per side. For a horizontal header wordmark, a 2048 × 256 px canvas is recommended; other proportions are welcome. Keep the artwork close to the canvas edges. Empty transparent margins are removed from the display export, never from your private original. Public display requires an approved, published artist page.
paletteNotice: Choose up to five colours. Enter a six-digit hex code or use your browser’s colour picker. Assign each surface once; targets used by another colour are unavailable. Shared colours override the theme only for their assigned surfaces. Your public logo follows the light or dark theme unless you assign and share a logo colour.

logoPreview.title: Preview logo
logoPreview.notice: Check your logo on light and dark backgrounds. Its proportions and colours stay unchanged. Choose Use logo, then Save to update your profile.
